admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; procedure for assessing curricular requirements and adequate personal preparation

admission_routes.notes: ESSE3 Eligibility Check and interview where not exempt.
Title-based selection for eligible foreign-degree holders, followed by Universitaly.

academic_requirements.summary: Three-year Bachelor's degree (or eligible foreign qualification). Ordinary route requires at least 60 CFU across at least two listed philological/literary, linguistic, philosophical, psychological, historical, sociological or complementary subject groups, including at least 6 CFU in L-LIN/01. International call requires a Humanities degree or another degree with solid basic linguistics preparation, completed by 30 June 2026.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Foreign qualification recognised as eligible; international-call curriculum must demonstrate solid basic training in linguistics.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.subject_area_or_ssd: At least two approved groups: philological/literary, linguistic, philosophical, psychological, historical, sociological, or complementary
minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Exact SSD lists are published on the programme requirements page.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: 75/100 or higher for international pre-admission. Ordinary-route interview exemption requires an eligible listed degree and grade at least 100/110.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Ordinary applicants undergo curricular review and, unless exempt, an interview on basic synchronic and diachronic linguistics. Non-EU applicants with foreign qualifications receive a title evaluation by the programme committee.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: International-call ranking due by 15 May 2026; one scholarship and up to four non-EU reduced-fee awards. No general admission cap stated.

selection_components.component: English above B2 and/or other language certificates at B1+

selection_components.notes: Only candidates with at least 70/80 on criteria 1-5; overall pass 60/100.

language_requirements.summary: English B2 or equivalent is required. For international-call applicants, a prior academic qualification taught in English is accepted instead of a certificate.
accepted_language_certificates: Certificates in the UNIVR equivalence list
Duolingo only for candidates from Iran or Afghanistan under the international call
certificate_exemptions: Previous academic qualification obtained in English under the international call
English competence acquired during the Bachelor's and recorded in the application evidence on the ordinary route
language_requirements.notes: English-taught Master's applicants are exempt from the general Italian language test.

required_documents.document: Identity document; passport for non-EU applicants

required_documents.condition: Preferably includes ECTS, weighted average, grading range.
Used in the published selection criteria.

required_documents.document: English B2 certificate or evidence of prior qualification taught in English
Self-certification listing exams, marks and SSDs/areas

document_legalisation_translation_rules: Successful international applicants submit official translation and legalisation of the diploma plus Declaration of Value; CIMEA Comparability and Verification statements may substitute respectively.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Interview on basic synchronic and diachronic linguistics / international-call online interview
entry_exam_or_test.mode: In person for listed ordinary-route sessions; online interview under the international call
entry_exam_or_test.language: English or Italian for ordinary interview; not specified for international-call interview
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: International call: 60/100 overall; interview held only for applicants with at least 70/80 before interview
alternatives: Ordinary-route interview exemption for specified degree classes with grade at least 100/110
entry_exam_or_test.notes: Ordinary interviews take place at Prof. Chiara Maria Concina's office. Non-EU international-call evaluation follows its separate criteria.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission fee, deducted on enrolment except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment €358; second and third variable by ISEEU/equivalent ISEE. Differentiated international flat rates and call awards may apply.

double_degree_options.notes: Separate double-degree selection; not initial programme admission.

source_quotes.quote: Duration 2 years ... Degree class LM-39 ... Administrative headquarters verona ... Language English
at least 60 CFU obtained in two or more ... groupings ... 6 must be in SSD L-LIN/01
adequacy of personal preparation is verified through an interview in English or Italian
Three-year University Degree ... in Humanities or other field requiring a solid basic training in linguistics ... Cumulative Grade Point Average ... 75/100 or higher

applicant_category_notes: The 31 March international call is limited to foreign-degree holders of non-Italian citizenship not already resident in Italy; the programme page separately governs ordinary applicants.

uncertainty_notes.issue: The international-call annex does not specify the interview language; the ordinary interview may be in English or Italian.
uncertainty_notes.resolution_needed: Confirm the language of the international-call interview with the programme.

uncertainty_notes.issue: No general admission-place quota is stated.
